subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `agents.*.iterationBudget` and the `onBeforeToolCallingRound`/`supportsIterationBudget` plugin harness contract with the proposed 90/50 defaults, final summary, and fail-closed unsupported-harness behavior?
rationale: Tests establish implementation correctness but cannot decide the long-term user-facing configuration or external plugin compatibility contract.

options.title: Approve current contract
options.body: Keep the opt-in config, proposed defaults, final text-only summary, and fail-closed harness capability requirement as supported behavior.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep the internal budget mechanism but defer or reduce the public config and plugin API until a smaller permanent contract is selected.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Continue relying on existing loop detection and run retry limits while a different safety model is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve current contract
recommendation.body: Keep the opt-in config, proposed defaults, final text-only summary, and fail-closed harness capability requirement as supported behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: She is assigned and authored the latest cross-runtime integration and proof commits, making her the strongest active owner for presenting the contract decision.
